label: Gentle Muse · Halloween
source: Source: Encyclopaedia Britannica, Mary Shelley · HAL-004

beats.html:
Mary Shelley started
Frankenstein in 1816, the
year without a summer.

Ash from a volcano on the
other side of the world
kept Europe under cloud.

Stuck indoors, bad weather,
nothing going right.
She invented a genre anyway.

clip.match_reason: The fact is Frankenstein begun in 1816 with Europe held under volcanic cloud, and the plate is a candlelit writing desk with an open journal and a quill, storm weather over the lake through the window.
